audit.whatIsWrong: The packet's own defect list is right: the page names none of Yi's abilities and gives no cooldowns. Three decisive interactions were missing — Meditate is a channel Facebreaker cancels, Alpha Strike makes him untargetable so a combo spent into it is wasted, and Highlander makes him immune to slows, which is what actually turns off Knuckle Down and the Show Stopper slow late.
audit.why: Riot's text: W 'restoring Health and taking reduced damage' with 'for each second he channels' — a flat 10s channel. Q 'simultaneously becoming untargetable', 20s at rank 1 at 600 range, and his basic attacks reduce its cooldown. E Wuju Style is a flat 14s granting TRUE damage on his autos, so armour is not the answer. R Highlander is 85s and grants immunity to all slowing effects.
audit.corrected: Facebreaker cancels Meditate (flat 10s). Alpha Strike: 20s at rank 1, untargetable through the dash — wait it out. Wuju Style: flat 14s, true damage on autos. Highlander: 85s and slow-immune.
